dialogues.jp:
未だに音夢の、人を蔑んだ目が｛のうり／脳裡｝に張り付い
ている。
dialogues.en: I could see Nemu's scowling face in my mind's eye.
dialogues.text: I could see Nemu's scowling face in my mind's eye.

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと学校に忘れただけでそんな顔をするこ
とはないだろうに。
dialogues.en:
The face was what was bringing me to school to do something
I had forgotten.
dialogues.text:
The face was what was bringing me to school to do something
I had forgotten.

dialogues.jp: 日曜の午後だというのに、学校へ行く俺。
dialogues.en:
Which is why on a Sunday afternoon, I was heading towards
the school.
dialogues.text:
Which is why on a Sunday afternoon, I was heading towards
the school.

dialogues.jp:
普段の俺から見れば、日曜に学校へ行く愚か者
と嘲笑の対象になるだろう。
dialogues.en:
Normally, I'd be exactly the type to laugh at the fools who
would go to school on a Sunday.
dialogues.text:
Normally, I'd be exactly the type to laugh at the fools who
would go to school on a Sunday.

dialogues.jp:
忘れ物ぐらいいいじゃないかと笑われそうだが、
月曜提出の課題のプリントをまるごと忘れたの
だからそうもいかない。
dialogues.en:
But as long as it's only for something forgotten, handouts
for Monday's presentation, I convinced myself that it was
alright.
dialogues.text:
But as long as it's only for something forgotten, handouts
for Monday's presentation, I convinced myself that it was
alright.

dialogues.jp:
杉並なら、たかが数日遅れたところで大した問
題にならないだろうとにこやかに肩を叩いてく
れるのだろうけれど、
dialogues.en:
Normally, Suginami would do these things, but he's been late
for school for several days now, so responsibility fell to
me.
dialogues.text:
Normally, Suginami would do these things, but he's been late
for school for several days now, so responsibility fell to
me.

dialogues.jp:
その課題が既に２週間も遅れていることを考え
ると、さすがに笑ってもいられない。
dialogues.en:
Considering that I've already delayed this for two weeks,
it's not really a laughing matter anymore.
dialogues.text:
Considering that I've already delayed this for two weeks,
it's not really a laughing matter anymore.

dialogues.jp:
次に忘れたら、暦先生は、俺を動物実験の被験
体にすると嬉しそうに言うのだから、忘れる訳
にはいかない。
dialogues.en:
If I forget to do it again, Koyomi-sensei would start using
me as a test subject for her experiements...
dialogues.text:
If I forget to do it again, Koyomi-sensei would start using
me as a test subject for her experiements...

dialogues.jp:
あの嬉しそうな顔は、俺が課題を忘れるのを待っ
ている。ヤツを喜ばせてはならない……。
dialogues.en:
I bet she's happily waiting for me to forget again, that
teacher...
dialogues.text:
I bet she's happily waiting for me to forget again, that
teacher...

dialogues.jp:
日曜日の午後だというのに、何人か学校に来て
いるようだ。
dialogues.en:
For a Sunday afternoon, there was a surprising amount of
students in school.
dialogues.text:
For a Sunday afternoon, there was a surprising amount of
students in school.

dialogues.jp:
校舎の周りや教室に、制服を着た学生がうろつ
いているのが見える。
dialogues.en:
All around the school and in classrooms, I could see
students in their school uniforms.
dialogues.text:
All around the school and in classrooms, I could see
students in their school uniforms.

dialogues.jp:
これじゃあ、制服を着ていない俺は、やけに不
審者みたいじゃないか。
dialogues.en:
Not wearing a uniform myself, I would probably look pretty
suspicious.
dialogues.text:
Not wearing a uniform myself, I would probably look pretty
suspicious.

dialogues.jp:
学校に来るんだから、ウソでも制服を着てくる
んだった……。
dialogues.en:
It's practically an iron-clad rule to wear your uniform
while in school...
dialogues.text:
It's practically an iron-clad rule to wear your uniform
while in school...

dialogues.jp: さっさと用件を済ませて帰ろう……。
dialogues.en: I better hurry up with my business and get outta here...
dialogues.text: I better hurry up with my business and get outta here...

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　朝倉じゃない。何しにきたの？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? Asakura? What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? Asakura? What are you doing here?"

dialogues.jp:
教室に入った瞬間、そこにいた眞子が珍しいも
のでも見るような目で俺を見る。
dialogues.en:
Upon entering the classroom, Mako, who was already inside,
looked at me with a puzzled face.
dialogues.text:
Upon entering the classroom, Mako, who was already inside,
looked at me with a puzzled face.

dialogues.jp: 「……ちょっと野暮用でな」
dialogues.en: "...Nothing, just some minor business."
dialogues.text: "...Nothing, just some minor business."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「今日は、日曜日よ？」
dialogues.en: "But, you here? On a Sunday?"
dialogues.text: "But, you here? On a Sunday?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「うるさいな、お前の方こそ、その日曜日にな
　んで学校に来てるんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Enough already. Besides, it's the same for you. Why're you
here on a Sunday?"
dialogues.text:
"Enough already. Besides, it's the same for you. Why're you
here on a Sunday?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あたし？　あたしは、音楽部の練習よ。ほら、
　卒業パーティーで発表することになってるか
　ら」
dialogues.en:
"Me? I was practicing with the music club. Haven't you seen
the publications about the graduation party?"
dialogues.text:
"Me? I was practicing with the music club. Haven't you seen
the publications about the graduation party?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「はぁん、大変だな」
dialogues.en: "...Oh, I see."
dialogues.text: "...Oh, I see."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「で、あんた何しに来たのよ」
dialogues.en: "So, what about you?"
dialogues.text: "So, what about you?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「い、いいだろ、別に！」
dialogues.en: "G, geez, nothing much already, I told you!"
dialogues.text: "G, geez, nothing much already, I told you!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、眞子に罵声を浴びせかけながら、自分の
机の中に入っているプリントを回収する。
dialogues.en:
With Mako's boos ringing in my ears, I go to my desk and
take out the handouts from inside.
dialogues.text:
With Mako's boos ringing in my ears, I go to my desk and
take out the handouts from inside.

dialogues.jp:
眞子には見えないように見えないように鞄に入
れたのだが、どうも見られてしまったようで、
彼女はにやあっと笑うのだった。
dialogues.en:
I tried to stuff it in my bag while Mako wasn't looking, but
she was too quick, and a knowing smile crept onto her face.
dialogues.text:
I tried to stuff it in my bag while Mako wasn't looking, but
she was too quick, and a knowing smile crept onto her face.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ〜ん、まだそれ出してなかったんだ……」
dialogues.en: "Heh, so that's what you came back for."
dialogues.text: "Heh, so that's what you came back for."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「わ、悪いかよ！」
dialogues.en: "T, that's horrible!"
dialogues.text: "T, that's horrible!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「悪いに決まってるでしょ、提出は今月の頭だっ
　たんだから！」
dialogues.en:
"If I'm horrible, you should take a look at yourself and
your presentation first!"
dialogues.text:
"If I'm horrible, you should take a look at yourself and
your presentation first!"

dialogues.jp: ごもっとも。
dialogues.en: She's quite right, actually.
dialogues.text: She's quite right, actually.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、俺はもう帰るからな！　練習、せい
　ぜい頑張ってくれ」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I'm going back! Work hard during practice!"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I'm going back! Work hard during practice!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は半ばイヤミにそう言うと、出口へ向かった。
dialogues.en:
As I half-sarcastically said that, I started making my way
out of the classroom.
dialogues.text:
As I half-sarcastically said that, I started making my way
out of the classroom.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あんたさぁ、校内でその私服、浮いててカッ
　コ悪いわよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Geez, don't you at least have the grace to come here in
your uniform?"
dialogues.text:
"Geez, don't you at least have the grace to come here in
your uniform?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「……まさか日曜にこんなに学生が来てるとは
　思わなかったんでな」
dialogues.en:
"...I didn't think there'd be so many students here on a
Sunday."
dialogues.text:
"...I didn't think there'd be so many students here on a
Sunday."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「この時期は、けっこうあたしみたいなのが多
　いのよ。ま、恥ずかしいから、なるべく人に
　見られないように帰るのね」
dialogues.en:
"During this period, I tend to see lots who do. Well, you
should just hurry up and go back now to avoid embarassment."
dialogues.text:
"During this period, I tend to see lots who do. Well, you
should just hurry up and go back now to avoid embarassment."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「大きなお世話だ、このやかまし女」
dialogues.en: "I didn't ask for your advice, you noisy girl."
dialogues.text: "I didn't ask for your advice, you noisy girl."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「な、……なんですってぇ！？」
dialogues.en: "W, what did you just call me!?"
dialogues.text: "W, what did you just call me!?"

dialogues.jp:
眞子の怒りが爆発しないうちに、さっさと逃げ
よう。
dialogues.en: I decided to run before Mako's fury reached breaking point.
dialogues.text: I decided to run before Mako's fury reached breaking point.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、教室を出て、いちもくさんに昇降口に向
かった。
dialogues.en:
I rushed out of the classroom, and headed for the school
entrance at full speed.
dialogues.text:
I rushed out of the classroom, and headed for the school
entrance at full speed.

dialogues.jp:
背後から、眞子の怒り狂う声が聞こえるが、こ
れだけ離れれば、追っては来ないだろう。
dialogues.en:
To my rear, I could hear Mako's raging voice, but I should
be out of range by now.
dialogues.text:
To my rear, I could hear Mako's raging voice, but I should
be out of range by now.

dialogues.jp: 「しかし、眞子の言うことももっともだな……」
dialogues.en: "But I suppose what she said was right..."
dialogues.text: "But I suppose what she said was right..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は自分の格好を見直す。
dialogues.en: I took a good look at my appearance.
dialogues.text: I took a good look at my appearance.

dialogues.jp:
別に、身なりが悪い訳ではないのだが、学校で
他に制服を着た連中が歩いている中で私服とい
うのはなんだか浮いている気がする。
dialogues.en:
I don't look horrible now, but I'd certainly look more
appropriate in a school uniform while walking down these
halls.
dialogues.text:
I don't look horrible now, but I'd certainly look more
appropriate in a school uniform while walking down these
halls.

dialogues.jp:
まるで、卒業生が昔を懐かしんで学校に遊びに
来たみたいだ。
dialogues.en:
Besides, it'd be pretty weird for one of the graduating
alumni to be just here "playing around".
dialogues.text:
Besides, it'd be pretty weird for one of the graduating
alumni to be just here "playing around".

dialogues.jp: 俺は、そこまで歳を取っているつもりはない。
dialogues.en:
I shouldn't give such a bad impression to the younger
students.
dialogues.text:
I shouldn't give such a bad impression to the younger
students.

dialogues.jp: 「……こっそりと帰るか」
dialogues.en: "...Better go back quietly."
dialogues.text: "...Better go back quietly."

dialogues.jp:
校庭の端っこを歩き、体育館の裏を通り、その
まま桜公園に出てしまえば、後は一般人となん
ら変わりはない。
dialogues.en:
From the edge of the campus, through the backdoor of the gym
and into the Sakura Park, not a path any ordinary person
takes.
dialogues.text:
From the edge of the campus, through the backdoor of the gym
and into the Sakura Park, not a path any ordinary person
takes.

dialogues.jp: 「こっそり、こっそり……」
dialogues.en: "Softly, softly..."
dialogues.text: "Softly, softly..."

dialogues.jp: 人通りの少ない場所を選んで、校庭に出る。
dialogues.en: With the path of least traffic decided, I exited the campus.
dialogues.text: With the path of least traffic decided, I exited the campus.

dialogues.jp:
後は、体育館の方へ行けば、人通りはより少な
くなる。
dialogues.en: The path from here to the gym should be empty.
dialogues.text: The path from here to the gym should be empty.

dialogues.jp:
体育館の裏は、普通は不良のたまり場になって
たりするのだが、あいにくうちにはその手の手
合いはいないので、気にすることはない。
dialogues.en:
The back of the gym isn't a particularly good gathering
spot, so I should be safe there too.
dialogues.text:
The back of the gym isn't a particularly good gathering
spot, so I should be safe there too.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、日なたであるにもかかわらず、忍び足で
体育館の方に向かう。
dialogues.en:
After reassuring myself, I continue on my stealthy way to
the gym.
dialogues.text:
After reassuring myself, I continue on my stealthy way to
the gym.

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず、じめっとしているところだ。日の
当たっている場所もあるにはあるが、やはり全
体的には、薄暗く陰気な場所だ。
dialogues.en:
As expected, no one is here. The place is so dim and gloomy,
it'd be surprising if anyone was here in the first place.
dialogues.text:
As expected, no one is here. The place is so dim and gloomy,
it'd be surprising if anyone was here in the first place.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、明るく楽しい体育館裏なんてのは聞いた
ことがないが。
dialogues.en:
But I suppose I've never heard of the back-entrance of a gym
that was bright and cheerful.
dialogues.text:
But I suppose I've never heard of the back-entrance of a gym
that was bright and cheerful.

dialogues.jp: 大きく地面に落ちた影の一部が動く。
dialogues.en: I suddenly saw a large shadow moving on the ground.
dialogues.text: I suddenly saw a large shadow moving on the ground.

dialogues.jp: 「──こんなところに人？」
dialogues.en: "--There's someone here?"
dialogues.text: "--There's someone here?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、茂みをよけ、見通しのいい場所に出る。
dialogues.en: I emerged from the thickets to get a better view.
dialogues.text: I emerged from the thickets to get a better view.

dialogues.jp:
そこにはひとりの少女がいて、しゃがみ込んで
何かをしているようだった。
dialogues.en:
A single girl was there. She was squatting down, but I
wasn't sure what exactly she was doing.
dialogues.text:
A single girl was there. She was squatting down, but I
wasn't sure what exactly she was doing.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺が入ってきたのに気づくと、驚いた
表情で俺の方を見た。
dialogues.en:
When I emerged from seemingly nowhere, I apparently
frightened her as she looked in my direction.
dialogues.text:
When I emerged from seemingly nowhere, I apparently
frightened her as she looked in my direction.

dialogues.jp:
その子は髪の色や瞳の色など、微妙に日本人離
れをした顔をしており、その不思議な目で、俺
のことをじーっと見ていた。
dialogues.en:
The girl, whose hair and eye colour seemed to signify roots
outside Japan, stared at me with her mysterious eyes.
dialogues.text:
The girl, whose hair and eye colour seemed to signify roots
outside Japan, stared at me with her mysterious eyes.

dialogues.jp:
「や、驚かせて悪ィ。あ、別に怪しいものじゃ
　ないぞ？　こんな格好してるけど、ここの学
　生だぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, sorry for scaring you. I don't look suspicious do I? I
look like a student, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Ah, sorry for scaring you. I don't look suspicious do I? I
look like a student, right?"

dialogues.jp:
女の子は、俺とは違って、ちゃんと制服を着て
いた。リボンの色からすると、どうやら後輩の
ようだ。美春と同じ色だ。
dialogues.en:
Unlike me, the girl was wearing her school uniform. From the
colour of her ribbon, I could tell she was a lowerclassman.
dialogues.text:
Unlike me, the girl was wearing her school uniform. From the
colour of her ribbon, I could tell she was a lowerclassman.

dialogues.jp:
胸にへんてこりんな人形を抱いていて、なぜか
黒い革の手袋をはめていた。
dialogues.en:
She was holding a doll to her chest, and for some reason,
wearing black leather gloves.
dialogues.text:
She was holding a doll to her chest, and for some reason,
wearing black leather gloves.

dialogues.jp: 女の子は小さな声で、呟くようにそう言った。
dialogues.en: The girl whispered in an extremely small voice.
dialogues.text: The girl whispered in an extremely small voice.

dialogues.jp:
透き通るような声。俺はそのかすれ消えてしま
いそうな声に、俺はその子を壊してしまいそう
な気持ちにかられてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Almost a transparent one. As easily as her voice disappeared
into the air, I felt like touching this girl would make her
break.
dialogues.text:
Almost a transparent one. As easily as her voice disappeared
into the air, I felt like touching this girl would make her
break.

dialogues.jp: じーっと、何も言わずに俺の方を見る女の子。
dialogues.en: She continued staring at me without saying anything.
dialogues.text: She continued staring at me without saying anything.

dialogues.jp:
何を考えているのかよくわからない表情で、俺
を見ている。なんとなく苦手なタイプかも知れ
ない。
dialogues.en:
I examined her expression, but it gave nothing away as to
what she was thinking. She seemed like the frail type...
dialogues.text:
I examined her expression, but it gave nothing away as to
what she was thinking. She seemed like the frail type...

dialogues.jp: ここは、さっさと立ち去った方がいいな。
dialogues.en: I should quickly take my leave.
dialogues.text: I should quickly take my leave.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そそくさとこの場から離れるつもりだっ
たが、女の子の前にあるものがふと気になって
しまった。
dialogues.en:
I start to leave, when I notice something odd in front of
the girl.
dialogues.text:
I start to leave, when I notice something odd in front of
the girl.

dialogues.jp: 「それ、なにかの花？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, what kind of flower is that?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, what kind of flower is that?"

dialogues.jp:
女の子の前には、すらりと細く伸びた植物が生
えていた。
dialogues.en: In front of her, a long, slender plant was growing.
dialogues.text: In front of her, a long, slender plant was growing.

dialogues.jp:
茎には申し訳なさそうに葉っぱが何枚か生えて
いた。
dialogues.en: Several leaves had grown out from the stalk of the plant.
dialogues.text: Several leaves had grown out from the stalk of the plant.

dialogues.jp:
近くには、じょうろやスコップが置いてあるか
ら、多分世話か何かをしていたんだと思う。
dialogues.en:
Close to it was a watering can and a shovel. Looks like she
was helping it grow.
dialogues.text:
Close to it was a watering can and a shovel. Looks like she
was helping it grow.

dialogues.jp:
女の子は、返事をする訳でも、頷く訳でもなく
俺の方を見ていた。
dialogues.en: The girl inexplicably bowed, then continued looking at me.
dialogues.text: The girl inexplicably bowed, then continued looking at me.

dialogues.jp:
何か、｛いぶか／訝｝しげな……という程でもないのだが、
そう、まるで何か不思議なものをみるような目
で俺を見ているのだ。
dialogues.en:
I guess she thinks I'm suspicious... she has to, if those
mysterious eyes have been staring at me for all this time.
dialogues.text:
I guess she thinks I'm suspicious... she has to, if those
mysterious eyes have been staring at me for all this time.

dialogues.jp:
「あ、悪ィ。余計なことを聞いちゃったみたい
　だな。気にしないでくれ、すぐに通り過ぎる
　からさ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, sorry, guess I've said too much unneccessary stuff.
Sorry for wasting your time, I'd leave now."
dialogues.text:
"Well, sorry, guess I've said too much unneccessary stuff.
Sorry for wasting your time, I'd leave now."

dialogues.jp:
俺がそう言うと、女の子はわずかに口を開こう
として、きゅっと閉じる。
dialogues.en:
As I said that, the girl opened her mouth ever-so-slightly,
then immediately shut it tight again.
dialogues.text:
As I said that, the girl opened her mouth ever-so-slightly,
then immediately shut it tight again.

dialogues.jp:
ほんの少し、｛ちゅうちょ／躊躇｝したような表情が見えた後、
女の子はおもむろに、手袋を外して抱いていた
人形を撫でる。
dialogues.en:
With hesistance shown on her face, the girl removed her
gloves, and gently stroked her doll.
dialogues.text:
With hesistance shown on her face, the girl removed her
gloves, and gently stroked her doll.

dialogues.jp:
「アリスは驚いてるだけさ。別に気になんてし
　てないよ」
dialogues.en:
"Alice is just a bit frightened. Don't worry too much about
it."
dialogues.text:
"Alice is just a bit frightened. Don't worry too much about
it."

dialogues.jp: 「？　な、なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "? w, Who was that?"
dialogues.text: "? w, Who was that?"

dialogues.jp:
その女の子のものではない、別の声が聞こえて
きた。
dialogues.en: That didn't come from her... it was someone else's voice.
dialogues.text: That didn't come from her... it was someone else's voice.

dialogues.jp: 「腹話術……かなにか？」
dialogues.en: "Was that...ventriloquism?"
dialogues.text: "Was that...ventriloquism?"

dialogues.jp:
俺の目には、単純にその人形が喋っているよう
に見えた。
dialogues.en: My eyes moved down to the simple doll speaking to me.
dialogues.text: My eyes moved down to the simple doll speaking to me.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ボクはピロス。アリスの代わりに喋ってるだ
　けさ」
dialogues.en: "I'm Piros. Alice's substitute in talking with others."
dialogues.text: "I'm Piros. Alice's substitute in talking with others."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「は？　はぁ？」
dialogues.en: "Wha....wha?"
dialogues.text: "Wha....wha?"

dialogues.jp: ボクはピロス……ってなに？
dialogues.en: I'm Piros... what's that?
dialogues.text: I'm Piros... what's that?

dialogues.jp: 女の子がすっと立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: The girl continued standing there silently.
dialogues.text: The girl continued standing there silently.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「お花、踏んだりしないでよね！」
dialogues.en: "Please don't step on the flower!"
dialogues.text: "Please don't step on the flower!"

dialogues.jp:
人形がそう言うと、女の子はそそくさとじょう
ろやスコップを片づけて、まるで逃げるように
してどこかにいってしまった。
dialogues.en:
So saying that, the girl quickly took her watering can and
shovel, and ran off.
dialogues.text:
So saying that, the girl quickly took her watering can and
shovel, and ran off.

dialogues.jp: いったい、あの子……なんなんだ？
dialogues.en: What on earth is up with this girl?
dialogues.text: What on earth is up with this girl?

dialogues.jp: ふと地面に何かが落ちていた。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, I noticed something on the floor that she dropped.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, I noticed something on the floor that she dropped.

dialogues.jp: 「──学生手帳？」
dialogues.en: "--A student notebook?"
dialogues.text: "--A student notebook?"

dialogues.jp:
あまりよい趣味ではないなと思いつつ、確かめ
ない訳にはいかないので、中を開いた。
dialogues.en:
Curious about this mysterious girl, I opened the book and
looked inside.
dialogues.text:
Curious about this mysterious girl, I opened the book and
looked inside.

dialogues.jp: 「月城……アリス、２年１組……か」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro...Alice, Year 2 Class 1."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro...Alice, Year 2 Class 1."

dialogues.jp:
住所は、……え〜と、うちの近くじゃないか。
今まであんな子見たことなかったな……。
dialogues.en:
The address is... quite close to my house, actually. I've
never seen her around though...
dialogues.text:
The address is... quite close to my house, actually. I've
never seen her around though...

dialogues.jp:
さっき、人形が喋ってた（こう言ってしまうの
はなんだか抵抗があるけど……）アリスという
のは、あの子の名前だったようだ。
dialogues.en:
Not to mention, that doll (with no real movement or sign
from the girl) addressed her as Alice as well.
dialogues.text:
Not to mention, that doll (with no real movement or sign
from the girl) addressed her as Alice as well.

dialogues.jp:
拾った以上は、やっぱり届けてあげるのが、ス
ジだろうな。ないと困るだろうし。
dialogues.en:
I kept it with me. Better that I'd be able to return it,
then leave it here.
dialogues.text:
I kept it with me. Better that I'd be able to return it,
then leave it here.

dialogues.jp:
──うちの近所なら、そんなに面倒くさい訳じゃ
なし。
dialogues.en:
--And it's not much of a bother to do so anyway, if it's in
the same neighbourhood.
dialogues.text:
--And it's not much of a bother to do so anyway, if it's in
the same neighbourhood.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、学生手帳を鞄に突っ込むと、桜公園を目
指して歩き始めた。
dialogues.en:
I throw the student notebook into my bag, and continue on to
the Sakura Park.
dialogues.text:
I throw the student notebook into my bag, and continue on to
the Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、さっきの女の子、あそこで何をしてた
んだろうか。
dialogues.en: Really though, what was that girl doing there?
dialogues.text: Really though, what was that girl doing there?

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、花を育てていたんだろうか。
dialogues.en: Probably trying to raise that plant...
dialogues.text: Probably trying to raise that plant...

dialogues.jp:
道具もちゃんと持ってたみたいだし、人形も最
後に気をつけてって言ってたし。
dialogues.en:
With all those tools she was carrying, and the doll's final
words of caution.
dialogues.text:
With all those tools she was carrying, and the doll's final
words of caution.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、鞄から手帳を取り出して、眺めてみる。
dialogues.en: I took the notebook from my bag, and look at it again.
dialogues.text: I took the notebook from my bag, and look at it again.

dialogues.jp:
写真を貼る欄には、にこりともしていない、無
表情なその子の顔があった。
dialogues.en:
On the page with her photograph on it, was an unsmiling,
emotionless girl's face.
dialogues.text:
On the page with her photograph on it, was an unsmiling,
emotionless girl's face.

dialogues.jp:
ま、証明写真にやたらと笑顔で写るヤツもいな
いか。
dialogues.en:
Well, no real need to smile for a photo used for these
purposes, I suppose.
dialogues.text:
Well, no real need to smile for a photo used for these
purposes, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あれ、朝倉先輩じゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "Ohh, it's Asakura-senpai!"
dialogues.text: "Ohh, it's Asakura-senpai!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「その声は……美春」
dialogues.en: "That voice... it's Miharu."
dialogues.text: "That voice... it's Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「こんなところで会うなんて奇遇ですねぇ。先
　輩もチョコバナナを買いに来たクチですか？」
dialogues.en:
"It's a surprise to meet you here! Are you here to taste the
park's chocolate banana?"
dialogues.text:
"It's a surprise to meet you here! Are you here to taste the
park's chocolate banana?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お前と一緒にするな」
dialogues.en: "What you're here for, you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What you're here for, you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あはは。実は私も音夢先輩に、マンガを返し
　に来た帰りなんですけどね」
dialogues.en:
"Ahaha, actually, I was meeting Nemu-senpai here to return a
manga I borrowed."
dialogues.text:
"Ahaha, actually, I was meeting Nemu-senpai here to return a
manga I borrowed."

dialogues.jp:
美春は、買ったばかりらしいチョコバナナをか
じりながら、笑っていた。
dialogues.en: Miharu smiled, holding her many chocolate bananas.
dialogues.text: Miharu smiled, holding her many chocolate bananas.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ところで、何を見てたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, what're you looking at?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, what're you looking at?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、これだよ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, just this."
dialogues.text: "Oh, just this."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、さっきまで見ていた月城アリスの学生手
帳を美春に見せる。
dialogues.en: I gave Tsukishiro Alice's notebook to Miharu for her to see.
dialogues.text: I gave Tsukishiro Alice's notebook to Miharu for her to see.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城さんのじゃないですか。どうしたんです
　か、これ？」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro-san's notebook, huh. Why's it with you?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro-san's notebook, huh. Why's it with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「知ってるのか？」
dialogues.en: "You know her?"
dialogues.text: "You know her?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「隣のクラスの子ですからねぇ。それにちょっ
　と変わった子だし」
dialogues.en: "She's in the class next door. She's a bit... different."
dialogues.text: "She's in the class next door. She's a bit... different."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「確かに変わってるって言えば、変わってるな」
dialogues.en: "More than just a bit, I would think."
dialogues.text: "More than just a bit, I would think."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「会ったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "You've met her?"
dialogues.text: "You've met her?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっとな。なんか、すぐにどこかにいっ
　ちゃったけど」
dialogues.en: "Sort of. She ran off almost instantly, though."
dialogues.text: "Sort of. She ran off almost instantly, though."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あの子、変じゃなかったですか？」
dialogues.en: "She's kind of weird, don't you think?"
dialogues.text: "She's kind of weird, don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ヘン？」
dialogues.en: "Weird?"
dialogues.text: "Weird?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ええと、その、ほら、月城さん、人形持って
　るでしょう？」
dialogues.en: "Well, you know, that doll she always carries around?"
dialogues.text: "Well, you know, that doll she always carries around?"

dialogues.jp:
美春は、もじもじと何かを言いにくそうにして
いる。
dialogues.en: Miharu hesitantly approached the subject.
dialogues.text: Miharu hesitantly approached the subject.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、彼女の代わりに、
dialogues.en: As if a substitute for Miharu,
dialogues.text: As if a substitute for Miharu,

dialogues.jp: 「──人形が喋るとか？」
dialogues.en: "--The doll that talks, you mean?"
dialogues.text: "--The doll that talks, you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、やっぱり」
dialogues.en: "Ah, just as I thought."
dialogues.text: "Ah, just as I thought."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「さすがに腹話術か何かだと思うんですけどね。
　自分の口からは、あまり喋らないし……」
dialogues.en:
"I think she must be a really good ventriloquist. Her own
mouth never moves when it talks."
dialogues.text:
"I think she must be a really good ventriloquist. Her own
mouth never moves when it talks."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いつもああなんだ」
dialogues.en: "Her own mouth never really moves anyway."
dialogues.text: "Her own mouth never really moves anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね。美春もあんまりお話ししたこと
　はないから、よくわからないんですけど。み
　んなはなんだか気味悪がってますね」
dialogues.en:
"Hehe, yeah. I don't know why, but she doesn't really talk
to me when I try to, or with anyone else for that matter."
dialogues.text:
"Hehe, yeah. I don't know why, but she doesn't really talk
to me when I try to, or with anyone else for that matter."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そっか……。まあ、それでその子が手帳を落
　として行ったみたいでさ。うちの近くみたい
　だから、届けてやろうかなと」
dialogues.en:
"I see... in any case, she dropped the notebook while she
was running off. Since the address is close, I'm going to
return it."
dialogues.text:
"I see... in any case, she dropped the notebook while she
was running off. Since the address is close, I'm going to
return it."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「なるほど、そういうことですか。じゃあ、美
　春が案内してあげますよ」
dialogues.en: "So that's how it is. Then I'd guide you to her place!"
dialogues.text: "So that's how it is. Then I'd guide you to her place!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「知ってるのか？」
dialogues.en: "You know whre it is?"
dialogues.text: "You know whre it is?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、ちょっと離れたところに、古めかしい
　お屋敷があるでしょう？　あそこですよ」
dialogues.en:
"You see that old mansion, seperated from the rest of the
houses?"
dialogues.text:
"You see that old mansion, seperated from the rest of the
houses?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あのお化け屋敷か」
dialogues.en: "Eh? That haunted mansion?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? That haunted mansion?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ちゃんと人住んでますよ……。それに、結構
　小綺麗にされてるじゃないですか」
dialogues.en:
"That's where she lives... and I think it sort of looks
pretty!"
dialogues.text:
"That's where she lives... and I think it sort of looks
pretty!"

dialogues.jp:
まあ、確かに壁にツタやらなんやかやが生えて
るだけで、別に幽霊が出たという話がある訳で
はない。
dialogues.en:
Well, even if it looks a bit haunted, if there's people
living inside it, I guess I won't see ghosts coming out of
the walls...
dialogues.text:
Well, even if it looks a bit haunted, if there's people
living inside it, I guess I won't see ghosts coming out of
the walls...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ささ、というわけだから、行きましょう」
dialogues.en: "Both ways, enough talk, let's go!"
dialogues.text: "Both ways, enough talk, let's go!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "O, okay..."
dialogues.text: "O, okay..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、まるで美春に引きずられるようにして、
月城アリスのお屋敷に向かった。
dialogues.en:
Pulled along by Miharu, we visited Tsukishiro Alice's
residence.
dialogues.text:
Pulled along by Miharu, we visited Tsukishiro Alice's
residence.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春も、遊びに行ったことはないんですけど
　ね」
dialogues.en: "I've never been this close to the mansion before..."
dialogues.text: "I've never been this close to the mansion before..."

dialogues.jp:
俺と美春は、うちの近くのお屋敷の前に行き、
ベルを鳴らす。
dialogues.en:
Miharu and I were right in front of the mansion, and I
pressed the bell.
dialogues.text:
Miharu and I were right in front of the mansion, and I
pressed the bell.

dialogues.jp:
すると、中から体格のよい初老の男性が現われ
た。簡単に用件を伝えると、渋みのある声で、
俺達を中に招き入れてくれた。
dialogues.en:
Soon after, a middle-aged man with a well-built physique
appeared. After stating our business, we were ushered
inside.
dialogues.text:
Soon after, a middle-aged man with a well-built physique
appeared. After stating our business, we were ushered
inside.

dialogues.jp:
「──それで、お嬢様の学生手帳を届けて頂い
　た訳ですね」
dialogues.en:
"--So the mistress's notebook came into your posession
through that manner."
dialogues.text:
"--So the mistress's notebook came into your posession
through that manner."

dialogues.jp: 「はい、それで、月城さんは……」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Uhm, is Tsukishiro-san here...?"
dialogues.text: "Yes. Uhm, is Tsukishiro-san here...?"

dialogues.jp:
「お嬢様は本日おでかけになっております。お
　帰りになるには、もうしばらくかかると思い
　ますが、いかがいたしましょう」
dialogues.en:
"The mistress is currently not at home. I believe she will
take a short while longer to return."
dialogues.text:
"The mistress is currently not at home. I believe she will
take a short while longer to return."

dialogues.jp:
「ええと、そしたら、とりあえず返しといても
　らえますか？」
dialogues.en: "Well, then could you give this back to her in my place?"
dialogues.text: "Well, then could you give this back to her in my place?"

dialogues.jp: 「畏まりました。それで、お名前は……」
dialogues.en: "Most certainly. May I have your name?"
dialogues.text: "Most certainly. May I have your name?"

dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい。朝倉[name]って言います」
dialogues.en: "Oh, of course. I'm Asakura [name]."
dialogues.text: "Oh, of course. I'm Asakura [name]."

dialogues.jp: 「風見学園付属の３年生です」
dialogues.en: "Student of Kazami Academy, 3rd year."
dialogues.text: "Student of Kazami Academy, 3rd year."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「えっと、美春は……ついてきただけなんです
　けど、２年の天枷美春です」
dialogues.en: "Ehh, I am... same as him, except 2nd year, Amakase Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Ehh, I am... same as him, except 2nd year, Amakase Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様と天枷様、でございますね。お嬢様に
　お伝えしておきます。あ、申し遅れましたが、
　わたくし、瀬場、と申します」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-sama and Amakase-sama, it shall be. I will pass
that on as well. Ah, I almost forgot about myself. Please
call me Seiba."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-sama and Amakase-sama, it shall be. I will pass
that on as well. Ah, I almost forgot about myself. Please
call me Seiba."

dialogues.jp:
俺と美春は、おいしいお茶を入れてもらったり
と、丁寧なおもてなしを受ける。
dialogues.en:
Miharu and I politely receive the delicious-looking tea that
he served us.
dialogues.text:
Miharu and I politely receive the delicious-looking tea that
he served us.

dialogues.jp: 「え、月城はここでひとり暮らしを？」
dialogues.en: "Erm, is Tsukishiro living here alone?"
dialogues.text: "Erm, is Tsukishiro living here alone?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「はい、お嬢様はご両親を亡くされておりまし
　て。私めと数人の使用人と共に暮らしており
　ます」
dialogues.en:
"That is so. The mistress's parents have both passed away.
Several other servants and myself, live here with the
mistress."
dialogues.text:
"That is so. The mistress's parents have both passed away.
Several other servants and myself, live here with the
mistress."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだったんですか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「でも、朝倉様や天枷様のようなお知り合いが
　できて、私も喜んでおります」
dialogues.en:
"However, I am very glad to see that the mistress is
acquainted with Asakura-sama and Amakase-sama."
dialogues.text:
"However, I am very glad to see that the mistress is
acquainted with Asakura-sama and Amakase-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「いや、知り合いって言っても……、今日初め
　て会ったばかりだから」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it's not really acquainted in my case... today was
more or less the first time we met."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it's not really acquainted in my case... today was
more or less the first time we met."

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんは、それでも嬉しゅうございますとにっ
こり笑った。
dialogues.en:
Even with my halfhearted denial, Seiba-san continued smiling
happily.
dialogues.text:
Even with my halfhearted denial, Seiba-san continued smiling
happily.

dialogues.jp:
その後、俺と美春は、瀬場さんと他愛もない話
をし、月城屋敷を後にした。
dialogues.en:
After a bit more idle conversation with Seiba-san, Miharu
and I left the Tsukishiro mansion.
dialogues.text:
After a bit more idle conversation with Seiba-san, Miharu
and I left the Tsukishiro mansion.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「なんだか、大きいお屋敷でしたね。美春はあ
　んな家は初めてですよ」
dialogues.en:
"That mansion was really huge! The first time I've ever been
in a house like that."
dialogues.text:
"That mansion was really huge! The first time I've ever been
in a house like that."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、あんな屋敷に住んでて、しか
　も執事みたいな人もいたし……」
dialogues.en: "Not to mention having a butler and other servants..."
dialogues.text: "Not to mention having a butler and other servants..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「マンガの中でしかいない人だと思ってました
　よ、ああいうの」
dialogues.en: "I bet there isn't a single manga in that house."
dialogues.text: "I bet there isn't a single manga in that house."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ポールとか、セバスチャンとか、そういうヤ
　ツだよな」
dialogues.en: "Ha, she's more likely to read Poe and Sebastian."
dialogues.text: "Ha, she's more likely to read Poe and Sebastian."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ひでじいとか、パーカーとか……」
dialogues.en: "And Hideji, and Parker..."
dialogues.text: "And Hideji, and Parker..."

dialogues.jp: 俺と美春は、うんうんと頷き合う。
dialogues.en: Miharu and I nodded in agreement.
dialogues.text: Miharu and I nodded in agreement.

dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、あの子……不思議な子だった
　な」
dialogues.en: "But anyway, that girl... she's still very mysterious."
dialogues.text: "But anyway, that girl... she's still very mysterious."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんか、いつも寂しそうなんですよね」
dialogues.en: "She must be lonely all the time..."
dialogues.text: "She must be lonely all the time..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうかもしれないな」
dialogues.en: "Probably..."
dialogues.text: "Probably..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、あの不思議な色をした大きな瞳を思い出
していた。
dialogues.en:
the big and mysterious-coloured eyes came flooding back into
my memory.
dialogues.text:
the big and mysterious-coloured eyes came flooding back into
my memory.

dialogues.jp: どこか｛はかな／儚｝げで、遠くを見ている目。
dialogues.en:
Empty eyes which seemed to be staring far away at
nothingness.
dialogues.text:
Empty eyes which seemed to be staring far away at
nothingness.

dialogues.jp:
透明で繊細なガラス細工。触れるとヒビが入っ
てしまいそうなそんなそんな感じだった。
dialogues.en:
She looked transparent and delicate, as if crafted out of
glass. It felt like touching her would make her break into
pieces.
dialogues.text:
She looked transparent and delicate, as if crafted out of
glass. It felt like touching her would make her break into
pieces.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「この機会に、お友達になれるといいんですけ
　どね」
dialogues.en: "We should try to befriend her."
dialogues.text: "We should try to befriend her."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「──そうだな」
dialogues.en: "--You're right."
dialogues.text: "--You're right."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、あの体育館裏にひっそりと佇んでいた少
女を思い出しながら、そう言った。
dialogues.en:
With the memory of the girl standing in the deserted area of
the back of the gym still in my head, I muttered my
approval.
dialogues.text:
With the memory of the girl standing in the deserted area of
the back of the gym still in my head, I muttered my
approval.

dialogues.jp: ◆月城アリス◆
dialogues.en: ◆Tsukishiro Alice◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tsukishiro Alice◆

dialogues.jp: 日曜日に、忘れ物を取りに学校へ赴いた。
dialogues.en:
I went back to school on a Sunday to retrieve something I
forgot to.
dialogues.text:
I went back to school on a Sunday to retrieve something I
forgot to.

dialogues.jp:
卒業パーティー前のせいか、学生達が何人もい
て、私服の俺は、人目を忍ぶために、体育館裏
を通って帰ることにした。
dialogues.en:
Because the graduation party was coming soon, there were
lots of students still in the school. Feeling a bit shameful
in my casual clothes, I decide to try to sneak my way out
using the backdoor of the gymnasium.
dialogues.text:
Because the graduation party was coming soon, there were
lots of students still in the school. Feeling a bit shameful
in my casual clothes, I decide to try to sneak my way out
using the backdoor of the gymnasium.

dialogues.jp:
体育館裏には、ひとりの少女がいた。透明なガ
ラス細工のような女の子だった。
dialogues.en:
At the back of the gymnasium was a lone girl. She looked as
fragile as transparent glass.
dialogues.text:
At the back of the gymnasium was a lone girl. She looked as
fragile as transparent glass.

dialogues.jp:
何か植物をじっと見ていたのだが、話しかけて
もまともに答えてはくれず、持っていた人形で
腹話術を使って答えを返してくるのだった。
dialogues.en:
She was staring at a plant growing in front of her. Instead
of replying to my attempts to talk to her, she used a doll
she held close to her chest to answer my questions.
dialogues.text:
She was staring at a plant growing in front of her. Instead
of replying to my attempts to talk to her, she used a doll
she held close to her chest to answer my questions.

dialogues.jp:
奇妙な雰囲気の中、しばらく会話を交わしてい
たのだが、女の子（というより人形）は花に気
をつけて、と言い、どこかへ行ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
With such a weird atmosphere, the girl quickly cut the
conversation off, and after the girl (or rather, the doll)
warned to be careful around the plant, ran off somewhere.
dialogues.text:
With such a weird atmosphere, the girl quickly cut the
conversation off, and after the girl (or rather, the doll)
warned to be careful around the plant, ran off somewhere.

dialogues.jp:
彼女のいた場所には学生手帳が落ちており、俺
はそれを届けることにした。
dialogues.en:
In her rush, the girl dropped her student notebook, which I
retrieved off the floor.
dialogues.text:
In her rush, the girl dropped her student notebook, which I
retrieved off the floor.

dialogues.jp:
途中出会った美春と共に、彼女──月城アリス
の家に行き、学生手帳を届けるのだった。
dialogues.en:
I met Miharu en-route to her house, and we returned the
student notebook together.
dialogues.text:
I met Miharu en-route to her house, and we returned the
student notebook together.

dialogues.jp:
どことなく寂しげな彼女……この機会に仲良く
なれるといい。俺と美春はそう思うのだった。
dialogues.en:
We could somehow feel that this girl was lonely, and decided
to try and befriend her.
dialogues.text:
We could somehow feel that this girl was lonely, and decided
to try and befriend her.
